a o 05 HAR 2018

To

The Addl. Central PF Commissioners (Zones),
All RPFC’s (In-charge of Regional Offices)

Sub:- Review of long pending 7A/14B cases and confirmation of number of cases
pending with all RO, under Section 7A/14B - reg.

Sir,
Attention is invited to circulars containing instructions regarding initiation of penal

action / filing of prosecution against those establishments who commit default in
submission of returns/remittance of dues.

2; The ACC of zonal offices are requested to monitor the performance for disposal of
7A/14B cases of RO’s those are under their jurisdiction, on regular basis.

3. Further, as per prescribed procedure as on date 7A/14B cases are to be heard and
disposed through e-proceeding only. However, it is seen that there are 56,784 cases
pending as on 26.02.2018 in e-proceeding whereas as per compliance MIS Dashboard there
are 65,859 cases pending as on 26.02.2018. This indicates that either the current position is
not correctly entered in Compliance MIS by the field offices or still cases are not being heard
in e-proceedings.

4. Therefore all ACC’s are requested to immediately review the pendency of 7A/14B
cases as per e-proceedings and as per Compliance MIS and ensure that necessary action is
taken by the field offices under their jurisdiction to ensure that the data in both matches
perfectly without any gap in between.

[This issues with the approval of ACC — HQ (Compliance)]

Yours faithfully,

(Rizwan Uddin
Regional PF Commissioner-I (Compliance-I)
